editorial:
Imagine waking up on the worst day of your life, only to have a total stranger knock on your door. That is exactly what happens to Stella. She is in a very dark place and ready to give up on everything when this charming guy shows up claiming he booked her guest room. He seems to know way too much about her, which is creepy but also kind of interesting. The vibe starts off slow and moody, but it quickly turns into a tense game of cat and mouse. You will feel for Stella as she goes from feeling totally alone to feeling trapped in her own home with someone she cannot quite figure out.

What really makes this work is the tension that builds when Stella's ex-boyfriend, Sandro, crashes the party. The acting is solid and the twists keep you guessing about who is actually the villain here. While some parts of the story feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you love stories about secrets and lies, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture quality, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the small details.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the stranger is not a random guest, but someone who has been stalking Stella and planning this meeting. He wants to punish Sandro for how he treated her. In the final scenes, the tension peaks in a violent clash between the two men. Stella eventually has to fight for her own life. The movie ends with a shock that shows how far people will go when they are obsessed with revenge.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers with a big twist.
